id.description: Lowercase words joined by hyphens, e.g. "knight-sacrifice".

moves.description: Moves in SAN with move numbers, e.g. "1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6". Legality is checked by `pnpm lessons`.

sources.description: Sources cited, by a key of your choosing. Each must match a gathered source collection by title (and author, if given).

cite.description: A source annotation: the source's key, and the position its text annotates.

at.description: Moves from the start position to the annotated position, e.g. "5.Nxf7 Bxf2+"; "" is the start itself. The start is the lesson's `start`, or the opening's root for a course overview. A line beginning at move 1 ("1.e4 e5 2.d4 …") is read from the initial position instead, to cite a source on a position before the start.

chapter.description: For a study that annotates the position in several chapters: the chapter's name, as the review page shows it.

explanation.description: Commentary that may only condense what the cited passages say. Text with no citation is rejected; with nothing to cite, use `"text": null` and the move shows with the sources' judgments and the engine alone.

form.description: How the text relates to its sources. Required when there is text.

status.description: "reviewed" once a person has checked the text against the cited passages on the review page.

reviewedAgainst.description: Stamped by the checker: a fingerprint of the cited text at review. Delete it to re-review.
